description: Classifies relationship types into support/provenance/structural graph edges and spec-level semantic relationship observations. This registry is the single owner of relationship type classification policy.

support.description: Low-level support, provenance, or structural graph edges that connect observations to their sources, containers, or evidence. These are not spec Section 15 semantic relationship observations.

semantic.description: Spec Section 15 controlled relationship types. These are higher-level semantic relationship observations computed from time, masks, depth, transcript, speaker segments, and motion.

unclassified_behavior: Relationship types not listed in this registry are classified as unknown. Unknown types are not rejected but are reported honestly as unknown during traversal.
